name: playbook
description: Native, invisible-but-visible Claude Code steering layer: a one-line goal you confirm, kept in front of every agent along with your decisions in your own words, a picker that ranks five ways to run the work and lets you choose, an unease score built from what actually happens that makes Claude rethink, get a judge's view or ask you, a pause after every review so findings are weighed rather than blindly obeyed, an always-on Sonnet-builds and Opus-judges model rule, calm compaction that stops agents fearing the context limit, a comment guard that refuses narration in any language before it reaches your file, and offline notifications via Pushover or ntfy.
